note: Light a fictional FUTURE temple concept (a plan in 1999 — no temple exists yet). Rotate the wire tiles. Bulbs have resistance 1, the battery is 1 unit: current ≥ 0.75 = bright, ≥ 0.2 = dim, otherwise off. Rows list tiles in their SOLVED orientation; the game scrambles them.
legend: Tiles: '.' empty; wire tiles list their open sides (N E S W), e.g. 'WE', 'ES', 'WES'; 'B+N' battery with + on that side and − opposite; 'U:NS:id' bulb; 'S:WE:id' switch. Battery, bulbs and switches are fixed.

levels.title: Light the lantern
levels.hint: Make a loop: from + (top of the battery) around to the lantern and back to −.

levels.title: Two equal window lights
levels.goal: Both window bulbs must be equally BRIGHT.
levels.hint: Use the T-tiles so each bulb gets its own path to both ends of the battery (parallel).

levels.title: A switch for the door light
levels.goal: Window A always bright; the switch turns the Door light on and off.
levels.hint: The switch should sit only on the Door light's branch. Flip it (right stick ↑) to test both ways.

levels.title: Dim spire, bright window
levels.goal: Both spire bulbs glow DIM; the window bulb is BRIGHT.
levels.hint: Two bulbs in one chain (series) share the battery and glow dim. Route the spire as one chain up and over.
